name: Fruit Incremental! 🍊🍎
desc:
💖 WEEKLY UPDATES 💖

🍇 Grab some fruit, sell the fruit, grab more fruit!

🍍 Fruit incremental is a game about upgrading your way to the top!
🍉 There are six (6) fruits in the game to be collected, these fruits are unlocked in a variety of ways!
🍓 There are 20+ upgrades that is increasing every week!

Made with ❤️ by fifth_5
Fruits modeled by Dan (Chiselbottom)
Foliage by Buzz (BuzzWantMoney)
